validation_role: development tuning only; no independent new test available

guardrails.time: SVC <= 10% increase preferred, KNN decrease preferred; full matched measurement required before final selection

pilot_resource_adaptation.purpose: screening only; full 9x DOE not claimed complete; full fit required for adoption

followup_SW1_5.reason: SW1.5 was the other pilot-passing weight

combination_promotion.eligible_factors: full accuracy guardrail pass only; timing remains separate recommendation
combination_promotion.pilot_promotion: higher correct and macro-F1 than best eligible individual pilot, precision at least pilot baseline, official pilot correct >= baseline-1
combination_promotion.max_full_combo: one best passing combination, resource-constrained; remaining full combinations explicitly unmeasured

KNN.combination: only independent passing factors; recheck k and alpha after PCA

pilot_rule: distance functions pilot: 8000 stratified training rows, 320 balanced handmade development queries and 320 official development queries; rank and promote only if pilot macro F1 and accuracy improve, not final evidence; any other pilot due execution limit explicitly marked
stop_policy: no measured result fabricated; record unexecuted/failed stages, retain baseline until full guardrails and timing checked
